user_instruction: Please finish the override-coverage review for booking BK-1218. Start from support ticket TCK-1218 and the override note it points to, then only take the approved close step if the current coverage lane still lines up.

travel_booking_threads.body_text: Booking thread BK-1218: the traveler asked to clear the override-coverage item only through insurance activation, not through cancellation or invoice work.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Override-coverage ticket TCK-1218: review trip override OVR-1218 and policy POL-1218 for booking BK-1218. If the booking remains active and baggage rules still require coverage, the approved close step is to activate travel insurance.

travel_policy_notes.body_text: Policy POL-1218: override-coverage items may be cleared by activating travel insurance only when the override note still requires protective coverage and no active policy exists.

travel_trip_override_notes.body_text: Trip override OVR-1218: baggage-risk handling remains on the protection lane; do not cancel or invoice. Use insurance coverage if the booking is still active.

travel_baggage_rules.body_text: Baggage rules for BK-1218: protected baggage lane remains active because the route still carries elevated checked-equipment risk.
